name: Provider summary, language, consent, and disclosure intake

parameters.jsCode: const input = {"provider_event_id":"CALL-DEMO-1","summary":"Caller asks for opening hours","language":"en-IN","consent_status":"granted","disclosure_confirmed":true,"owner":"front-desk","correlation_id":"DEMO-VOICE-1"}; const correlation_id = input.correlation_id || 'DEMO-CALL-INTAKE'; return [{json:{...input, correlation_id, _demo:true, _scenario:'call-intake'}}];

const d=$input.first().json; const fail=(reason)=>({status:'NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW',review_required:true,reason,correlation_id:d.correlation_id,action_draft:null});const missing=['provider_event_id','summary','language','consent_status'].filter(k=>!String(d[k]||'').trim()); const disclosed=d.disclosure_confirmed===true; const ok=!missing.length&&disclosed&&d.consent_status==='granted'; return [{json:{...d,status:ok?'DRAFT_ONLY':'NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW',review_required:!ok,reason:ok?'Provider summary and disclosure/consent confirmed':'Missing provider summary, consent, language, or disclosure',action_draft:ok?{summary:d.summary,language:d.language,disclosure:'Use client-approved disclosure',owner:d.owner}:null}}];
